mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows) or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% in 3 months or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls and rise in unemployment rate indicates labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining PAYEMS and rising UNRATE fails to predict negative 20-day returns in >50% of cases or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles where the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, higher borrowing costs reduce corporate investment and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in <40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion that boosts corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST increases (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year windows) or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 115.0 in a 3-month window, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in <40% of instances when INDPRO < 115.0 in 3 months or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals stagflationary pressures that increase market uncertainty and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and declining GDPC1 fails to predict negative 60-day returns in >50% of cases or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In sustained high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), weak labor market conditions reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in <40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% or Rank IC falls below 0.03.
